introHtml: iLive speakers combine reliable audio performance with a sleek design that makes them a standout choice for corporate gifts and promotional events. Whether you're outfitting a trade show booth or rewarding employees, these speakers offer clear sound and easy Bluetooth pairing. Customize them with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving for a professional look that recipients will actually use.
